_meta.description: Material properties master. capacity_factor: multiplier on rated TPH (1.0 = granite baseline). abrasion: Low/Medium/High/Very High. Confirm values with engineering.

Granite.wear_parts_note: Standard Mn18 liners. Replace every 400-600 hrs.
Granite.special_notes: Baseline hard rock for PROMAN equipment rating.

Basalt.wear_parts_note: Mn22 recommended. High wear rate — budget 15-20% more for wear parts.
Basalt.special_notes: Very abrasive. VSI rotor tips wear faster. Increase spare parts holding.

Limestone.wear_parts_note: Mn13 liners. Long liner life — replace every 800-1000 hrs.
Limestone.special_notes: Soft rock — can step down jaw size by one model. +15% capacity over granite baseline.

Dolomite.special_notes: Similar to limestone. Check silica content if mixed with quartz veins.

Quartzite.wear_parts_note: Mn22 mandatory. Extreme wear — increase spare parts budget 30-40%.
Quartzite.special_notes: Hardest common aggregate rock. −15% capacity vs granite. Upgraded liners and rotor tips essential.

Quartz / Silica.wear_parts_note: Mn22 mandatory. Very high silica content — respiratory safety measures required on site.
Quartz / Silica.special_notes: Industrial mineral application. Engineering review required for wear part schedule. Dust suppression system mandatory.

Sandstone.wear_parts_note: Standard Mn13. Watch for clay/moisture content.
Sandstone.special_notes: Variable hardness. Test sample before finalising equipment selection.

Marble.wear_parts_note: Mn13. Low wear but check silica veins.
Marble.special_notes: Soft but may contain hard quartz/silica veins. Engineering check required.

Gypsum.wear_parts_note: Very low wear. Standard Mn13 will last very long.
Gypsum.special_notes: [TBC] Moisture sensitive — crushing dry gypsum is straightforward; wet gypsum can choke.

Iron Ore.wear_parts_note: Mn22. High density impacts conveyor capacity — review belt ratings.
Iron Ore.special_notes: [TBC] High SG (2.1) — conveyor and screen capacity derate required. Engineering review mandatory.

Recycled Concrete.wear_parts_note: Mn18. Watch for rebar — metal detector mandatory upstream.
Recycled Concrete.special_notes: Metal detector before primary jaw is mandatory. Variable feed quality.
